facts.fact: The NRB Strategic Plan 2025-2030 lists the 'National Digitalization Policy (2023)' among its legal and policy mandates, describing it as setting 'the national direction for digital transformation across all sectors of the economy and public service', and says government took steps including 'updating the National Digitalization Policy' during 2019-2024. The passages give no adopting act, body or verb of approval, so 'adopted' rests on the policy being treated as in force from 2023.

Two passages of the NRB Strategic Plan cite 'the Malawi Digital Strategy' and 'the Malawi Digital Strategy- 2019', saying government institutions 'have been encouraged to harness' technology under it; the passages give no description of its scope, no adopting act and no verb of approval, only the name and the year 2019.
